method: Every task runtime and legacy .runtime file hashed, textual/JSON embedded data decoded in primary scan; all remaining extensions scanned for exact PNG/design hashes and variant identity. Actual request/start/binding/raw/summary linkage distinguished from metadata references. Matching unknowns block reuse. No missing-summary inference.
explicit_non_evidence_exceptions: Two OS-exclusive 1-byte workbench.lock sentinels; exact code and size audited; contents not forcibly read.
zero_call_basis: No exact assigned PNG embedded request, binding/start/run/raw/summary or related-duplicate actual-call evidence across full task and legacy runtime. Every matching reference and malformed/placeholder record was preserved and classified. Missing summary was never the basis.
